title: Titration apparatus
caption: The analyte is measured into a conical flask with a pipette and a few drops of indicator added; the titrant is added from a burette until the indicator just changes colour. The titre is the final reading minus the initial reading, read at the bottom of the meniscus.
alt: A burette clamped above a conical flask containing the analyte and indicator; burette readings and the titre beside it.
